description: I1 drop, XPBD: same block and drop as i1_drop_ms.json (ground friction 0.5). Milestone render settings (Stage I1, chosen from the I1-08..10 previews): springs 150 N/m, volume stiffness matched between solvers (kv 1e6 Pa = compliance 1e-6 1/Pa). 100 substeps (at 50, the softer springs let the worst volume error reach 1.3%; at 100 it is 0.47%), the same as the XPBD shake.
